_readme: One entry per person. photo: path under /assets/img/team/ or empty string to show the reserved circular slot. Titles follow the team reference render in the requirements doc (CEO / President / CSO). Links: leave empty strings for ones not to be shown.

zh.title: 既能做实验，也能训模型
zh.lede: 临床医学与前沿 AI 研究出身的团队：把科学问题、数据与实验反馈，接进同一条发现链路。
nodes: 从真实的未知出发，把问题转化为可研究、可验证的形式。
围绕 DFM 蓝图，让模型在科学任务与真实反馈中学习。
调用工具、数据与实验环境，让判断接受现实检验。
把每一次结果沉淀为下一次发现的起点。
zh.join_body: 我们在寻找既关心科学问题、也愿意亲手构建系统的研究者与工程师。

en.title: People who can run the experiment and train the model
en.lede: A team from clinical medicine and frontier AI research, connecting scientific questions, data and experimental feedback into one discovery loop.
nodes: Start from a real unknown and turn it into a researchable, verifiable question.
Within the DFM blueprint, let models learn from scientific tasks and real feedback.
Call tools, data and experimental environments so judgements meet reality.
Turn every result into the starting point of the next discovery.
en.join_body: We are looking for researchers and engineers who care about scientific questions and want to build the systems themselves.

zh.name: 吴英成
zh.title: 联合创始人 · CEO
zh.affiliation: 斯坦福大学 AI 博士后 · 复旦大学临床医学
zh.bio: 临床医学出身，在斯坦福从事人工智能与病理学交叉研究，以第一作者身份在 Cell、Nature、Science 发表工作。关注如何让真实的科学问题、实验数据与验证条件进入下一代智能系统。
research: AI for 生命科学与生物医学
肿瘤微环境与患者响应建模

en.name: Yingcheng Wu
en.title: Co-founder & CEO
en.affiliation: AI postdoctoral scholar, Stanford · Clinical medicine, Fudan
en.bio: Trained in clinical medicine, now working at the intersection of AI and pathology at Stanford, with first-author papers in Cell, Nature and Science. Focused on bringing real scientific questions, experimental data and verification conditions into next-generation intelligent systems.
research: AI for life science and biomedicine

zh.name: 杨灵
zh.title: 联合创始人 · CSO
zh.affiliation: 普林斯顿大学博士后 · 北京大学（即将入职）
zh.bio: 普林斯顿大学 ECE 博士后，即将加入北京大学任助理教授。研究大模型与智能体后训练、强化学习系统、递归自我改进与 AI for Discovery。创建开源社区 Gen-Verse，代表工作包括 Buffer of Thoughts、ReasonFlux、MMaDA。
research: 大模型 / 智能体后训练
强化学习系统与基础设施

en.name: Ling Yang
en.title: Co-founder & CSO
en.affiliation: Postdoctoral researcher, Princeton · Incoming faculty, Peking University
en.bio: Postdoctoral researcher in ECE at Princeton and incoming assistant professor at Peking University. Works on LLM and agent post-training, reinforcement-learning systems, recursive self-improvement and AI for discovery. Founded the Gen-Verse open-source community; representative work includes Buffer of Thoughts, ReasonFlux and MMaDA.

zh.name: 尹臻非
zh.title: 联合创始人 · President
zh.affiliation: 牛津大学博士后 · 曾任职上海人工智能实验室、商汤科技
zh.bio: 牛津大学博士后研究员，曾任上海人工智能实验室研究员、商汤科技研究经理。长期从事多模态与具身智能研究，构建了多个被机器人、推理与多模态学习社区广泛使用的开放系统。

en.name: Zhenfei Yin
en.title: Co-founder & President
en.affiliation: Postdoctoral researcher, Oxford · formerly Shanghai AI Laboratory and SenseTime
en.bio: Postdoctoral researcher at the University of Oxford; previously a researcher at Shanghai AI Laboratory and a research manager at SenseTime. Works on multimodal and embodied intelligence, and has built open systems used across robotics, reasoning and multimodal learning.
